about: Every AI model file the app ships or builds from. Read by `photodedup check-models` (the gate) and by scripts/export-siglip2.py (which takes its source pins from here, so there is one copy). Models are bundled; the app never goes online. See models/README.md.

models.purpose: Image embedding: look-alike photos for the duplicate review, and zero-shot checks for possible defects (screenshots, documents, black or blown-out frames).

licence.evidence: Model card of google/siglip2-base-patch16-224 at the pinned commit (front matter: license: apache-2.0), published by Google under its own account.

training_data.name: WebLI
training_data.note: Google's internal web-scale image-text set, named on the model card and not published, so it cannot be audited. The licence on the weights is permissive; the data is the part we cannot verify.
